notes.subject: נכסף
notes.rationale: 'i no sem' (ASV/JPS) o 'lain manmeri ol i no laikim' (KJV 'not desired'); dua bilong Hibru i hat

notes.subject: התקוששו וקושו
notes.rationale: Tupela tok i tanim tok olsem klostu — hihitkoshshu vaqoshu — pasin bilong toktok i loss long Tok Pisin

notes.subject: התקוששו
notes.rationale: Tok i singautim lain manmeri long kam wantaim — pasin bilong tok bilong profet

translation: Kisim olgeta wantaim, kisim olgeta wantaim, o lain manmeri i no sem
